skill_name: With given input, create a rule-based system to identify cat breeds.
workflow: A rule-based system for identifying cat breeds can be created by analyzing an image's visual features and comparing them to known attributes of cats from different breeds. For example, comparing fur color, pattern, length, muzzle shape, and eye shape, can help identify Persian cats. Similarly, tail length and shape, muzzle shape, and ear shape can help identify a Siamese cat. Maine Coons can be identified through fur color and length, eyes, and presence of a ruff.
